fit_mhr_model_to_vertices: fit an MHR body model to target vertex positions using PyTorchMHRFitting with staged Adam optimization
fit_smpl_model_to_vertices: fit an SMPL or SMPLX body model to target vertex positions using PyTorchSMPLFitting with batched optimization
track_mhr_parameters_temporally: track MHR model parameters across temporal frames using PyTorchMHRFitting with chunked sequence tracking
track_smpl_parameters_temporally: track SMPL model parameters across temporal frames using PyTorchSMPLFitting with overlapping chunk tracking
select_frames_for_identity_estimation: select representative frames for identity estimation using BasePyTorchFitting based on edge distance to template mesh
